verdict.rationale: Token2 ships CLI/scriptable tools (fido2-manage CLI, PowerShell/GraphAPI bulk-enrollment for Entra ID) that could in principle be invoked in automated pipelines, but there is no documentation describing headless execution, CI integration, or non-interactive operation modes — and most tools inherently require a physically-inserted USB/NFC key, undercutting true headless use. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless-mode documentation, evidence of non-interactive execution without physical hardware presence, and any CI/pipeline integration examples.
